verified_facts.text: Baglioni Masseria Muzza is near Otranto, deep in the Salento countryside, surrounded by olive groves.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located near Otranto, and surrounded by verdant olive groves and the Sea, Baglioni Masseria Muzza Resort & Spa, is a historic property nestled deep in the Salento countryside.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is an 18th-century masseria in the Salento countryside.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stay in an 18th-century masseria nestled in the Salento countryside

verified_facts.text: Whitewashed walls and exposed wooden beams define the rooms and suites.
verified_facts.excerpt: Whitewashed walls and exposed wooden beams define the understated elegance of the resort

verified_facts.text: The Deluxe Sunset View room has a private patio overlooking the Salento sunsets.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bright and spacious, featuring a double bed, futon, and a private patio overlooking the enchanting colors of Salento sunsets.

verified_facts.text: The Junior Suite Sunset View has exposed stone ceilings and authentic furnishings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Featuring exposed stone ceilings and authentic furnishings, this suite offers a double bed, futon, and an outdoor space

verified_facts.text: The Deluxe Room has a bathroom with a chromotherapy shower and a private patio with sun loungers.
verified_facts.excerpt: An elegant room featuring a double bed and futon, a bathroom with shower and chromotherapy, and a private patio with sun loungers.

verified_facts.text: The Executive Suite is furnished in authentic Salento style, with a patio surrounded by greenery.
verified_facts.excerpt: Furnished in authentic Salento style, it offers spacious interiors, a double bed, a bathroom with double vanity, and a patio surrounded by greenery

verified_facts.text: The Otranto Family Suite has a living area, two double bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms and a furnished veranda.
verified_facts.excerpt: featuring a living area, two spacious double bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms and double vanities, and an elegant furnished veranda

verified_facts.text: The Deluxe Suite has Acqua di Parma bathroom amenities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spacious bathroom with Acqua di Parma amenities

verified_facts.text: The spa's Water Journey includes a hydromassage pool, Turkish bath, Finnish sauna, Kneipp path and sensory showers.
verified_facts.excerpt: beginning with an enchanting **hydromassage pool** and flowing through a **sensorial journey of Turkish bath**, **Finnish sauna, Kneipp path,** and **sensory showers.**

verified_facts.text: Hotel guests have access to The Water Journey as part of their stay.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests of Baglioni Masseria Muzza Resort & Spa enjoy complimentary access to The Water Journey as part of their stay.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers the Affusione di Levante water ritual.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience the invigorating embrace of the **_Affusione di Levante_** water ritual.

verified_facts.text: Access to the spa and fitness center is restricted to guests over 18; minors need an accompanying adult who has signed a liability waiver.
verified_facts.excerpt: Access to the spa and fitness center is restricted to guests over the age of 18. Minors may access these areas only if they are accompanied by an adult who has signed a liability waiver.

verified_facts.text: Aura Spa treatments are also open to people not staying at the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: All our treatments and services are also available to those who are not staying at **Baglioni Masseria Muzza Resort & Spa.**

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a Fitness Center with modern equipment.
verified_facts.excerpt: take advantage of the modern equipment in our Fitness Center

verified_facts.text: The hotel runs a shuttle to Salento beaches and to the center of Otranto.
verified_facts.excerpt: can be reached via the Masseria’s complimentary shuttle service, also available to the center of Otranto

verified_facts.text: The Baglioni Kids Club offers sports, games, arts and crafts and entertainment for young guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: At Baglioni Kids Club, our youngest guests can enjoy a variety of activities, such as sports, games, arts & crafts, entertainment & more.

verified_facts.text: The Sunset Bar looks out over the hills, olive groves and the Alimini lakes at sunset.
verified_facts.excerpt: Raise a glass to golden hour moments as the sun sets over the hills, olive groves, and the shimmering Alimini lakes.

verified_facts.text: Mirto Restaurant is a bistrot celebrating Apulian and Mediterranean flavours.
verified_facts.excerpt: A refined bistrot among the gentle hills of Salento, celebrating the authentic Apulian and Mediterranean flavours.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's gastronomic events include cooking classes, wine tastings, sunset aperitifs and evenings with traditional music.
verified_facts.excerpt: From cooking classes to dedicated menus, wine tastings, sunset aperitifs and evenings with traditional music and local flavours

verified_facts.text: Experiences offered include kayaking and snorkelling at Roca Vecchia.
verified_facts.excerpt: Kayak and Snorkelling in Roca Vecchia

verified_facts.text: Experiences offered include an olive oil tasting with picnic.
verified_facts.excerpt: Olive Oil Tasting with Picnic

verified_facts.text: Experiences offered include truffle hunting for the whole family.
verified_facts.excerpt: Truffle Hunting for the Whole Family

verified_facts.text: Experiences offered include an e-bike tour of Otranto and its surroundings.
verified_facts.excerpt: E-Bike Tour of Otranto and Its Surroundings

verified_facts.text: Experiences offered include a yacht experience along the Santa Maria di Leuca coast.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yacht Experience Along the Santa Maria Di Leuca Coast

verified_facts.text: The Pool Bar serves drinks and light fare during the day.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Pool Bar menu offers a range of drinks & light fare during the day.
